Would you like to join an international working environment?
Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you!

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

As part of the ASP service within the IT department, client is looking for a Software Asset Management Officer to ensure reliable, compliant, and optimized management of the IT software license portfolio.

The assignment combines administrative, analytical, and monitoring activities, with a strong focus on coordination between IT, Procurement, and Finance teams. The consultant will contribute to cost control, license compliance, and the continuous improvement of Software Asset Management processes.
Key Responsibilities

• Manage the complete lifecycle of IT licenses: request, approval, acquisition, deployment, monitoring, and renewal.

• Maintain an accurate, reliable, and up-to-date database of active, expired, renewable, and licenses to be retired.

• Analyze contracts, terms of use, and license clauses in collaboration with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams.

• Analyze software usage data to identify unused, underused, or oversized licenses.

• Propose optimization actions to reduce costs and improve license utilization.

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators covering active licenses, unused licenses, upcoming renewals, compliance risks, and potential savings.

• Prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards to support management decision-making.

• Provide administrative and analytical follow-up for Software Asset Management activities.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of SAM processes and data quality.

Strong Assets

• Experience with SAM/ITAM solutions.

• Strong knowledge of SQL and/or Power BI.

• Experience with software cost optimization and renewal management.

• Experience working in a complex IT or large-enterprise environment.

• Experience collaborating with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has solid experience in Software Asset Management or IT Asset Management, combined with strong administrative, analytical, and license-management skills.

They are able to work independently, analyze complex data, identify optimization opportunities, and communicate effectively with various internal and external stakeholders.

Mandatory Skills

• Minimum 3 years of experience in a role related to:

• Software Asset Management

• IT License Management

• IT Asset Management

• IT Procurement

• or a similar function.

• Good knowledge of software licensing models from major software vendors.

• Experience analyzing and monitoring software contracts and licensing terms.

• Strong ability to analyze software usage data.

• Good knowledge of at least one analytical tool such as advanced Excel, SQL, or Power BI.

• Ability to prepare analyses, reports, and dashboards.

• French or Dutch with fluent English.

• Strong administrative rigor and ability to manage multiple cases efficiently.

• Autonomous, proactive, and ownership-driven mindset.

Professional & Soft Skills

• Excellent analytical skills.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Autonomous and responsible.

• Proactive with a strong sense of initiative.

• Strong ownership and accountability.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with IT, Procurement, and Finance teams.

• Results-oriented and focused on continuous improvement.

• Critical thinking and solution-oriented approach.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you will join an international engineering and consultancy firm specialising in the design and delivery of complex technical projects.

Within this position, the focus is on Mission Critical Facilities and data centres. These are technically demanding buildings where systems such as electrical power supply, cooling, redundancy, safety and operational continuity need to be closely integrated.

You will become part of a Belgian engineering team that is being further developed around data centre projects. From Belgium, you will work closely with international engineering teams on projects for both national and international clients.

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where different technical areas of expertise come together to design and deliver complex projects.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - Saturday or weekdays
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

About K-Boringen:With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.

Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.

Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.

To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure. Our target group consists of workers who are eager to work—especially on-site abroad—who are flexible and skilled in languages.

Basic Requirements:

• Knowledge of hydraulics, welding, and cutting is a plus.
• A solid understanding of electricity is a must.
• Troubleshooting various malfunctions is a challenge for the ideal candidate.
• Preferably, some initial work experience as a laborer and a flexible mindset.
• Willingness to perform physically demanding and dirty work (but done calmly rather than hastily).
• No fear of confined spaces (claustrophobia).
• Fluent in Dutch (additional languages are a plus); if you can communicate well in English, German, or French, you may also qualify.
• Flexibility regarding location and work schedule.
Additional Information:

• You will primarily work within the country, but also regularly in Belgium’s neighboring countries (NL, DE, etc.).
• You will stay on-site from Monday to Friday. During weekends, you return home (you also receive a daily allowance for accommodation).
• You will not work every week of the year; there will be both busy periods (when execution takes place) and quieter periods.
• A driver’s license is not required.
